task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "Swap the banana and the pear.". This is a NEW job that the team has no ready-made skill for. Plan it yourself from the robot actions: find the items (drone_scan, recall), carry them one at a time (go_to, pick, then place_on('tray') or put_aside() on a station's table), and check every result. Do exactly what the operator asked; leave other items where they are. Afterwards an independent judge compares where every item was before and after. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: To swap two items while carrying only one at a time, temporarily stage the first item with put_aside on the second item's table to free the gripper, then ferry the second item back.

lesson: To swap two items then land the drone, stage the first item with put_aside on the second item's table to free the gripper, ferry the second item back, then call land_on_moving_robot() at the end.
